difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a locally finite type scheme flat at a point is essentially of finite presentation over the base at that point (statement lines 2908-2914, tag 05P9-adjacent). The proof embeds the source into an affine space over the base, applies the finite presentation result for a flat finite type module to the pushforward of the structure sheaf, and reads off the statement for the original local ring. The reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
